conventions.commits: Conventional commits with issue references (e.g., #1864); DCO signed; no unsigned commits
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files (mod.rs, language-specific .rs); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test patterns: parse_language(), query execution, capture verification, inheritance extraction
conventions.linting: cargo clippy with deny-level lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used; test-code exemptions via cfg_attr; cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: Result<T, AnalyzeError> or Option<T>; no unwrap/expect in non-test code; thiserror for error types; bounds checking on byte slices before text extraction

patterns: Language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants
LanguageInfo struct populated in get_language_info match arm with language::LANGUAGE.into() and optional handler functions
extract_inheritance walks parent nodes to find base_clause and class_interface_clause children, extracting named children as type names
DEFUSE_QUERY captures write sites (local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression) and read sites (identifier usage)
Extension map in lang.rs maps file extensions to language names; supported_languages() array lists all available languages
Tree-sitter query patterns use node kind matching and field_by_field_name() to extract identifiers and structure

PHP integration must cover all dimensions.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, trait_declaration nodes; base_clause and class_interface_clause carry extends/implements info
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as sibling nodes to class_declaration, not as fields. Functions are function_definition (not method_declaration). Enums support methods and implement interfaces. No parent_class/base_classes/interfaces fields exist.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query, QueryCursor, Node.child_by_field_name(), Node.named_child(), Node.kind(), Node.start_byte(), Node.end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Query API used for ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY; field access via child_by_field_name() for named fields; iteration via named_child() for multiple children

approaches.name: Comprehensive PHP Integration with Full Handler Suite
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to workspace.dependencies and Cargo.toml. Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, trait_declaration; CALL_QUERY for method/function calls; REFERENCE_QUERY for type names; IMPORT_QUERY for use statements; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variables, assignments, and identifier reads. Implement extract_inheritance handler to walk base_clause and class_interface_clause children. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language() match arms. Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs. Add 'php' to supported_languages() array. Include comprehensive unit tests covering all declaration kinds, inheritance patterns, and defuse sites.
pros: Complete semantic analysis support for PHP code
Consistent with existing language implementations (Java, Python, Kotlin)
Enables all downstream tools (symbol extraction, inheritance analysis, def-use tracking)
High code reuse via tree-sitter-php grammar
cons: Requires implementing extract_inheritance handler (non-trivial field walking)
DEFUSE_QUERY must handle PHP-specific patterns (e.g., $variable syntax)
More test cases needed to cover PHP-specific syntax (heredoc, traits, anonymous classes)

approaches.name: Minimal PHP Integration (Element Query Only)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency and create php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY (no DEFUSE_QUERY, no extract_inheritance). Register in mod.rs with None for optional handlers. Add extension map and supported_languages entry. This provides directory/symbol analysis without def-use tracking.
pros: Covers primary use case (symbol table extraction)
cons: Missing DEFUSE_QUERY means no def-use analysis (semantic correctness reduced)
No inheritance extraction (class hierarchy analysis unavailable)

approaches.name: PHP Integration with Deferred Inheritance Handler
approaches.description: Implement ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and DEFUSE_QUERY as in Approach 1, but defer extract_inheritance implementation to a follow-up issue. Register handler as None initially, document the deferred work in a TODO comment. This unblocks symbol extraction while deferring the most complex handler.
pros: Delivers most value (element extraction + def-use) in one PR
Defers only the most complex piece (inheritance walking)
Easier to review and merge incrementally
Matches maintainer preference for focused PRs
cons: Requires follow-up PR to close the gap
May be rejected if issue explicitly requires inheritance support

recommendation: Approach 1 (Comprehensive PHP Integration with Full Handler Suite). This approach delivers complete semantic analysis for PHP, consistent with existing language implementations (Java, Python, Kotlin, Rust). The issue title 'add PHP language support' implies full parity with other languages. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because semantic analysis (def-use tracking) is core to aptu-coder's value proposition (token-efficient symbol extraction). The extract_inheritance handler is essential for class hierarchy analysis, which downstream tools depend on. The complexity is medium (comparable to Java integration), and the test patterns are well-established in the codebase. This approach positions PHP as a first-class language in the system.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
"
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json): A class_declaration node has three fields: name (required), attributes (optional), and body (required). The base_clause and class_interface_clause are sibling nodes (not fields) that appear as children of class_declaration. To extract inheritance: (1) walk the class_declaration node's children to find base_clause nodes; (2) for each base_clause, iterate its named_child() to extract name nodes and convert to text (these are the extends parent classes); (3) walk the class_declaration node's children to find class_interface_clause nodes; (4) for each class_interface_clause, iterate its named_child() to extract name nodes and convert to text (these are the implements interfaces). The same pattern applies to interface_declaration (which can extend other interfaces via base_clause) and enum_declaration (which can implement interfaces via class_interface_clause).
